items.caption: A modern redraw of 后 in a Lesser Seal style: a long upright stroke stands to the left of a box-like form. This received seal-style rendering illustrates a later graphic form, but does not determine how 后 originated.
items.alt: Black seal-style character with a long, slightly curved vertical stroke on the left and a box-like enclosure on the right.
items.selection_reason: The visible graph is identifiable as 后 and the documented Shuowen-style seal redraw makes it useful for showing a received seal-form rendering. It does not resolve the competing accounts of 后’s early forms or establish a lineage into the received graph.

limitations.text: The early graphic origin of 后 remains unsettled. Accounts connect it with 司 or report an oracle form written with 毓, but neither establishes a complete sequence into this seal-style form or a secure component-by-component explanation.
